title: Inside Rams' camp plan to limit Matthew Stafford and test Ty Simpson, Stetson Bennett

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Inside Rams' camp plan to limit Matthew Stafford and test Ty Simpson, Stetson Bennett
sources.description: The Rams are giving Ty Simpson and Stetson Bennett plenty of reps in training camp as the two quarterbacks battle to be Matthew Stafford's backup.
